words.enDefinition: a dishonest scheme carried out online to obtain money or personal information

examples.en: The student newsletter described an online scam that several people had reported that week.
examples.zh: 学生通讯介绍了一起那周有多人举报的「网络诈骗」。

examples.en: I wasn't sure whether the message was an online scam, so I asked campus IT.
examples.zh: 我不确定这条消息是不是「网络诈骗」，就去问了校园 IT 部门。

words.enDefinition: a warning that informs people about a suspected or known scam

examples.en: A scam alert from the university appeared on the student portal that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，学生门户网站上出现了学校发来的「诈骗提醒」。

examples.en: The bank's scam alert included examples of messages customers had already reported to it.
examples.zh: 银行的「诈骗提醒」列举了客户已经举报过的一些消息。

words.enDefinition: fraudulent messages or sites that try to trick people into disclosing information or taking harmful actions

examples.en: The university's guide to phishing used a sample message that students could discuss in class.
examples.zh: 学校的「网络钓鱼」指南用了一个示例消息，学生可以在课堂上讨论。

examples.en: Our lecturer mentioned phishing after the help desk removed a suspicious email from student accounts.
examples.zh: 技术服务台从学生邮箱中移除一封可疑邮件后，讲师提到了「网络钓鱼」。

words.enDefinition: an email sent as part of a phishing attempt

examples.en: I reported the phishing email that had appeared to come from my course office.
examples.zh: 我举报了那封看起来来自课程办公室的「钓鱼邮件」。

examples.en: Campus IT confirmed the phishing email when I asked whether the notice was genuine.
examples.zh: 我询问通知是不是真的时，校园 IT 部门确认那是「钓鱼邮件」。

words.enDefinition: an instance of someone trying to trick a recipient through phishing

examples.en: The support desk treated the unexpected account request as a possible phishing attempt.
examples.zh: 技术服务台把那条意外收到的账户请求视为可能的「网络钓鱼企图」。

examples.en: The campus warning said a phishing attempt had been reported by several research students.
examples.zh: 校园警告写着，几名研究生举报了同一次「网络钓鱼企图」。

words.enDefinition: a page that pretends to be a genuine service's sign-in screen

examples.en: I closed the tab after the browser flagged a possible fake sign-in page.
examples.zh: 浏览器提示可能是「仿冒登录页面」后，我关掉了标签页。

examples.en: The university notice showed how to recognise a fake sign-in page using a fictional example.
examples.zh: 学校通知借一个虚构示例说明怎样识别「仿冒登录页面」。

collocations: warning about a fake sign-in page

words.enDefinition: a message whose sender, content, or purpose makes it seem potentially unsafe

examples.en: I received a suspicious message about a payment I did not recognise that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，我收到一条跟一笔陌生付款有关的「可疑消息」。

examples.en: My roommate asked the residence office whether they had sent the suspicious message.
examples.zh: 室友问宿管办公室，那条「可疑消息」是不是他们发的。

words.enDefinition: a link that seems unreliable or that might lead somewhere unsafe

examples.en: I shared a screenshot of the suspicious link with the campus support desk for review.
examples.zh: 我截了「可疑链接」的图，发给校园技术服务台核查。

examples.en: The seminar included a short discussion about recognising a suspicious link in a message.
examples.zh: 研讨课简短讨论了如何识别消息里的「可疑链接」。

words.enDefinition: a link intended to lead users to harmful content or a deceptive site

examples.en: The campus IT team confirmed that the email contained a malicious link that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，校园 IT 团队确认邮件里有「恶意链接」。

examples.en: A warning page blocked the malicious link when the security test was displayed in class.
examples.zh: 课上演示安全测试时，警告页面拦截了那个「恶意链接」。

words.enDefinition: a sender identity made to appear as though a message came from another source

examples.en: The technician identified a spoofed sender address in the email I had reported.
examples.zh: 技术人员在我举报的邮件里发现了「伪造的发件人地址」。

examples.en: A spoofed sender was listed among the reasons the help desk had blocked the email.
examples.zh: 技术服务台列出拦截这封邮件的理由，其中包括「伪造的发件人身份」。

words.enDefinition: the name shown alongside a message, which can differ from its sending address

examples.en: The sender display name looked familiar, but I couldn't recognise the rest of the message.
examples.zh: 「发件人显示名」看着眼熟，但邮件其他内容我都不认得。

examples.en: I checked the sender display name against the address after the university sent its warning.
examples.zh: 学校发出提醒后，我把「发件人显示名」和邮箱地址做了核对。

collocations: compare the sender display name with the address

words.enDefinition: the email address shown as the source of a message

examples.en: I checked the sender address because the subject line looked unusual for our course.
examples.zh: 标题不像我们课程平时的写法，所以我核对了「发件人地址」。

examples.en: The adviser compared the sender address with the one in our official staff directory.
examples.zh: 顾问把「发件人地址」与正式员工名录里的邮箱作了比对。

words.zhGloss: 身份未经核验的发件人
words.enDefinition: a sender whose identity has not been confirmed by the service
acceptedZhAnswers: 身份未经核验的发件人

examples.en: The app marked the email as coming from an unverified sender that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，应用把这封邮件标为「身份未经核验的发件人」所发。

examples.en: I asked what unverified sender meant before replying to the message from outside campus.
examples.zh: 回复校外消息前，我先问了「身份未经核验的发件人」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: to check that a message came from the person or institution it claims

examples.en: I called the department to verify the sender of the message about our final exam.
examples.zh: 我给系里打了电话，就期末考试通知「核实发件人身份」。

examples.en: The training asked us to verify the sender before trusting an unexpected payment request.
examples.zh: 培训请我们先「核实发件人身份」，再判断意外收到的付款请求是否可信。

collocations: take time to verify the sender
ask how to verify the sender

words.enDefinition: the internet domain actually used by an organization for its official services

examples.en: I compared the address on the message with the university's official domain before replying.
examples.zh: 回复之前，我把消息里的地址与学校的「官方域名」做了比较。

examples.en: The help desk confirmed the official domain listed in our orientation guide was still correct.
examples.zh: 技术服务台确认，迎新指南里列出的「官方域名」仍然正确。

words.enDefinition: the registered name used as an address for a site or internet service

examples.en: The browser displayed the domain name at the top of the page near the tab.
examples.zh: 浏览器在页面顶部的标签旁显示了「域名」。

examples.en: I asked the librarian whether that domain name belonged to our university's new service.
examples.zh: 我问图书管理员那个「域名」是不是我们学校的新服务使用的。

words.enDefinition: a domain name resembling another that may be mistaken for the genuine one

examples.en: Campus IT reported a lookalike domain after checking the address in the suspicious message.
examples.zh: 校园 IT 部门检查了可疑消息里的地址，举报了一个「仿冒官方的近似域名」。

examples.en: I recognised the name from the security alert about a lookalike domain targeting our university.
examples.zh: 我从针对我们学校的「仿冒官方的近似域名」安全提醒里认出了这个名称。

words.enDefinition: to look at the address of a webpage to confirm its identity

examples.en: I paused to check the web address after opening the department's help page again.
examples.zh: 重新打开系里的帮助页面后，我停下来「核对网页地址」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to check the web address in the example on screen.
examples.zh: 导师请我们看屏幕上的示例，练习「核对网页地址」。

collocations: remember to check the web address
ask someone to check the web address

words.enDefinition: the communication information published by the organization itself

examples.en: I used the official contact details from the university website to verify the appointment.
examples.zh: 我用学校网站上的「官方联系方式」核实了预约。

examples.en: The adviser pointed me to the official contact details printed inside our student handbook.
examples.zh: 顾问给我指了学生手册里印的「官方联系方式」。

words.enDefinition: a known communication route that can be used to reach someone reliably

examples.en: I checked through a trusted contact channel when the message appeared to come from my adviser.
examples.zh: 消息看起来像导师发的，我用「可靠的联系渠道」核实了一下。

examples.en: The bank referred me to a trusted contact channel listed in its official app.
examples.zh: 银行让我用官方应用中列出的「可靠的联系渠道」沟通。

collocations: confirm through a trusted contact channel

words.enDefinition: a short link that directs a user to a longer web address

examples.en: I asked campus IT about the shortened link because its destination was unclear to me.
examples.zh: 因为不清楚「缩短后的网址链接」指向哪里，我问了校园 IT 部门。

examples.en: The event organizer sent the full address after I asked about the shortened link.
examples.zh: 我问起「缩短后的网址链接」后，活动组织者发来了完整地址。

collocations: replace a shortened link with the full address

words.enDefinition: a file included in a message when the recipient was not expecting one

examples.en: I told the help desk about an unexpected attachment from a number I didn't know.
examples.zh: 我告诉技术服务台，陌生号码发来了一个「意外收到的附件」。

examples.en: The tutor confirmed that the unexpected attachment was her updated worksheet for the seminar.
examples.zh: 导师确认，这个「意外收到的附件」是她更新过的研讨课练习单。

words.enDefinition: an attempt to make a person respond before they have time to think or check

examples.en: The student guide described pressure to act quickly as one warning sign in suspicious requests.
examples.zh: 学生指南把「催促立即采取行动」列为可疑请求的一项警示信号。

examples.en: The helpline asked whether I felt pressure to act quickly during the call.
examples.zh: 热线人员问，通话时对方是否让我感到被「催促立即采取行动」。

collocations: respond to pressure to act quickly

words.enDefinition: a message or question asking someone to provide identifying personal details

examples.en: I checked with the registrar about an unexpected request for personal information in my inbox.
examples.zh: 收件箱里有条意外的「索要个人信息的请求」，我向教务处核实了。

examples.en: The bank said the request for personal information had not come from its support team.
examples.zh: 银行说，那项「索要个人信息的请求」并非其支持团队发出的。

collocations: receive a request for personal information
verify a request for personal information
review a request for personal information

words.enDefinition: private or important information that could cause harm if disclosed to the wrong people

examples.en: The course policy explained which sensitive information should not appear in student project files.
examples.zh: 课程规定说明了学生项目文件不应包含哪些「敏感信息」。

examples.en: I asked whether the form requested any sensitive information before opening it in class.
examples.zh: 课上打开表格前，我问它是否要求填写「敏感信息」。

words.zhGloss: 切勿把验证码告诉别人
words.enDefinition: a notice telling users to keep an authentication code private
acceptedZhAnswers: 切勿把验证码告诉别人

examples.en: The message said never share your code above the entry for my recent sign-in.
examples.zh: 消息在最近一次登录的记录上方写着「切勿把验证码告诉别人」。

examples.en: I saw never share your code in the help article the bank sent me.
examples.zh: 银行发给我的帮助文章里写着「切勿把验证码告诉别人」。

collocations: remember never to share your code

words.enDefinition: a fabricated invoice presented as though a genuine payment were owed

examples.en: The accounts office confirmed the phony invoice did not belong to our student society.
examples.zh: 财务办公室确认，那张「伪造的付款账单」与我们的学生社团无关。

examples.en: I asked the event organizer about the phony invoice after spotting a different address.
examples.zh: 我发现地址不同，就向活动组织者询问了那张「伪造的付款账单」。

words.enDefinition: a deceptive message claiming a transaction was made when it was not

examples.en: The help desk saved a copy of the fake payment confirmation for its report.
examples.zh: 技术服务台保存了一份「伪造的付款确认」，用于撰写报告。

examples.en: My classmate recognised the fake payment confirmation after checking the account record directly.
examples.zh: 同学直接查了账户记录，识破了「伪造的付款确认」。

words.enDefinition: a scam that uses a false claim about a parcel or delivery

examples.en: The residence office warned students about a parcel delivery scam reported in our area.
examples.zh: 宿管办公室提醒学生，我们这一带已有人举报「快递投递诈骗」。

examples.en: I read the parcel delivery scam notice while waiting for my book order to arrive.
examples.zh: 等买的书送到时，我读了「快递投递诈骗」的提醒。

collocations: warning about a parcel delivery scam

words.enDefinition: a dishonest scheme claiming to offer scholarship money or help applying for it

examples.en: The financial aid office discussed a scholarship scam during our first orientation session.
examples.zh: 助学办公室在第一次迎新会上讲到了一起「奖学金诈骗」。

examples.en: Campus IT flagged the message as a scholarship scam after hearing from several students.
examples.zh: 收到几名学生的反馈后，校园 IT 部门把该消息标为「奖学金诈骗」。

words.enDefinition: a scheme asking for money upfront for a benefit the victim never receives

examples.en: The student advice centre gave an example of an advance-fee scam in its handout.
examples.zh: 学生咨询中心在讲义里举了一个「要求预付费用的诈骗」的例子。

examples.en: The message was flagged as an advance-fee scam before anyone paid the requested amount.
examples.zh: 在有人付出所要费用前，这条消息就被标为「要求预付费用的诈骗」。

collocations: warn people about an advance-fee scam

words.enDefinition: a scheme pretending to collect tuition charges or offer a discount on tuition

examples.en: The university sent a warning about a tuition payment scam before the new semester.
examples.zh: 新学期前，学校发了一份有关「学费支付诈骗」的提醒。

examples.en: I asked the accounts office whether the message was part of the tuition payment scam.
examples.zh: 我问财务办公室，这条消息是不是「学费支付诈骗」的一部分。

collocations: warn students about a tuition payment scam
notice about a tuition payment scam

words.enDefinition: a scam in which someone pretends to offer technical support

examples.en: Campus IT warned about a tech support scam targeting new students this week.
examples.zh: 校园信息技术部门提醒，新生本周要留意「假冒技术支持诈骗」。

examples.en: We discussed a tech support scam during orientation and saved the real helpdesk number.
examples.zh: 入学培训时我们讨论了「假冒技术支持诈骗」，还存下了真正的服务台号码。

collocations: a warning about a tech support scam

words.enDefinition: a scam in which someone claims to be a trusted person or organisation

examples.en: My roommate reported an impersonation scam after checking with the university finance office.
examples.zh: 室友向学校财务处核实后，举报了一起「冒充身份诈骗」。

examples.en: The university posted advice about an impersonation scam on its official student website.
examples.zh: 学校在正式学生网站上发布了有关「冒充身份诈骗」的防范建议。

words.enDefinition: a scam in which someone exploits a supposed romantic relationship to obtain money or information

examples.en: The student newspaper covered a romance scam without naming the people who were affected.
examples.zh: 校报报道了一起「假借恋爱关系诈骗」，省去了受影响人士的姓名。

examples.en: She contacted student support after a friend raised concerns about a possible romance scam.
examples.zh: 朋友提醒她可能遇上「假借恋爱关系诈骗」后，她联系了学生支持部门。

collocations: the signs of a romance scam

words.enDefinition: manipulation that tricks people into giving access or sharing protected information

examples.en: Our induction covered social engineering alongside other risks that students might encounter online.
examples.zh: 入学培训介绍了「社交工程欺骗」以及学生上网时可能遇到的其他风险。

examples.en: The guide describes social engineering in everyday language suitable for first-year students.
examples.zh: 指南用适合大一学生的日常语言解释了「社交工程欺骗」。

words.enDefinition: phishing carried out through SMS or similar text messages

examples.en: The student guide explains smishing in the section about suspicious text messages.
examples.zh: 学生指南在介绍可疑短信的章节解释了「短信钓鱼」。

examples.en: Our tutor mentioned smishing when several students asked about unexpected texts on campus.
examples.zh: 几名学生问起在校园里收到的陌生短信时，导师提到了「短信钓鱼」。

words.enDefinition: phishing carried out through phone calls or other voice communications

examples.en: We learned about vishing in the session on staying safe during phone calls.
examples.zh: 我们在通话安全讲座上了解了「语音通话钓鱼」。

examples.en: Campus IT included vishing in its notice about suspicious calls to student accommodation.
examples.zh: 校园信息技术部门在关于学生宿舍可疑来电的通告中提到了「语音通话钓鱼」。

words.enDefinition: a phone call intended to trick the recipient into paying money or revealing information

examples.en: I ended the scam call and contacted the office using its published number.
examples.zh: 我挂断「诈骗电话」，按公开号码联系了办公室。

examples.en: The resident adviser asked whether anyone else had received the same scam call that morning.
examples.zh: 宿舍辅导员问，当天上午还有没有别人接到同样的「诈骗电话」。

collocations: hang up on a scam call

words.enDefinition: a call made by an automated system that typically plays a recorded message

examples.en: The library uses a robocall to remind borrowers when requested books are ready.
examples.zh: 图书馆用「自动拨号语音电话」提醒读者预约的书已经可以领取。

examples.en: I received a robocall about the closure while walking to the bus stop.
examples.zh: 我走去公交站时接到一通「自动拨号语音电话」，告知暂停开放。

words.enDefinition: a mailbox folder for messages marked as unwanted or likely to be spam

examples.en: I found the workshop invitation in my spam folder the day before registration closed.
examples.zh: 报名截止前一天，我在「垃圾邮件文件夹」里找到了工作坊邀请。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to check the spam folder if the reading list was missing.
examples.zh: 导师说，如果没收到阅读书单，可以看看「垃圾邮件文件夹」。

words.zhGloss: 标记为垃圾邮件或消息
words.enDefinition: to label a message as unwanted so the service can filter it accordingly
acceptedZhAnswers: 标记为垃圾邮件或消息

examples.en: Use Mark as spam on the unwanted advertisement at the top of your inbox.
examples.zh: 对收件箱顶端那条不想要的广告，点「标记为垃圾邮件」。

examples.en: I clicked Mark as spam when the same advertisement appeared for the third time.
examples.zh: 同一条广告第三次出现时，我点了「标记为垃圾邮件」。

words.enDefinition: to notify a service or organisation about a suspected phishing message or site

examples.en: Use the campus help page to report phishing if you suspect a message is fraudulent.
examples.zh: 如果怀疑一条消息有诈，可以用校园帮助页面「举报网络钓鱼」。

examples.en: The tutor showed us where to report phishing in our university email service.
examples.zh: 导师给我们看了在校邮箱服务的什么位置可以「举报网络钓鱼」。

collocations: use the button to report phishing

words.enDefinition: to tell an authority, platform or support service about an attempted or completed scam

examples.en: I asked student services how to report a scam involving a fake scholarship message.
examples.zh: 我向学生服务处询问如何「举报诈骗」，事情涉及一条虚假的奖学金通知。

examples.en: The consumer agency's help page explained where students could report a scam.
examples.zh: 消费者机构的帮助页面说明了学生可以去哪里「举报诈骗」。

collocations: report a scam to the platform
learn where to report a scam

words.enDefinition: an online or paper form used to submit details about a scam

examples.en: I opened the scam reporting form from the consumer agency's main help page.
examples.zh: 我从消费者机构的帮助首页打开了「诈骗举报表」。

examples.en: The adviser helped me find the scam reporting form after our morning meeting.
examples.zh: 早上的会面结束后，顾问帮我找到了「诈骗举报表」。

words.enDefinition: a designated place or method for sending a report about a concern

examples.en: The university has a dedicated reporting channel for suspicious messages in student email.
examples.zh: 学校有专门的「举报渠道」，处理学生邮箱收到的可疑消息。

examples.en: We checked which reporting channel the platform recommends for concerns about account impersonation.
examples.zh: 我们查了平台建议通过哪个「举报渠道」反映账号冒充的问题。

words.enDefinition: the university group responsible for keeping campus information systems and accounts secure

examples.en: The campus IT security team published a warning after students reported suspicious messages.
examples.zh: 学生举报可疑消息后，「校园信息安全团队」发布了提醒。

examples.en: Our adviser asked the campus IT security team to confirm that the notice was genuine.
examples.zh: 顾问请「校园信息安全团队」确认这则通知确实是真的。

collocations: contact the campus IT security team
ask the campus IT security team
guidance from the campus IT security team

words.enDefinition: training that teaches people to recognise information security risks and respond appropriately

examples.en: New lab assistants completed security awareness training before they received their university accounts.
examples.zh: 新实验室助理拿到校园账户前，先完成了「安全意识培训」。

examples.en: The university added examples about student email to its security awareness training this year.
examples.zh: 学校今年在「安全意识培训」中加入了学生邮件相关案例。

words.enDefinition: an official notice about a security concern and any recommended protective action

examples.en: The security advisory explained which software versions needed changes before the next workshop.
examples.zh: 「信息安全公告」说明了哪些软件版本需要在下次工作坊前更新。

examples.en: Campus IT shared a security advisory on the student portal after the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末过后，校园信息技术部门在学生门户发布了「信息安全公告」。

words.enDefinition: a notice confirming that a service has received a report

examples.en: I saved the reporting confirmation because it included the reference for my submission.
examples.zh: 我保存了「举报提交确认」，因为里面有这次提交的编号。

examples.en: The reporting confirmation appeared on screen as soon as I submitted the form.
examples.zh: 我一提交表格，屏幕上就显示了「举报提交确认」。

words.expression: save a copy of the message
words.lemma: save a copy of the message
words.enDefinition: to keep a separate copy of a message for later reference
acceptedEnVariants: save a copy of the message

examples.en: The adviser asked me to save a copy of the message for our appointment.
examples.zh: 顾问请我「保存一份消息副本」，见面时好查阅。

examples.en: I chose to save a copy of the message before clearing out my mailbox.
examples.zh: 清理邮箱之前，我决定先「保存一份消息副本」。

collocations: save a copy of the message for reference
need to save a copy of the message
remember to save a copy of the message

words.enDefinition: to stop a particular person or address from messaging you through a service

examples.en: I decided to block the sender after receiving several unwanted messages from the same address.
examples.zh: 同一地址发来好几条我不想收的消息后，我决定「屏蔽发件人」。

examples.en: Our email app asks whether to block the sender when we flag an unwanted message.
examples.zh: 标记不想接收的消息时，我们的邮件应用会询问是否「屏蔽发件人」。

collocations: use the menu to block the sender

words.enDefinition: the list of addresses or contacts whose messages a service blocks

examples.en: I checked my blocked sender list after missing several reminders from the language club.
examples.zh: 错过语言社的几次提醒后，我查看了「已屏蔽发件人名单」。

examples.en: The blocked sender list moved to a different page after the email application changed.
examples.zh: 邮件应用改版后，「已屏蔽发件人名单」移到了另一个页面。

collocations: add an address to the blocked sender list

words.enDefinition: a system that detects or sorts unwanted or unsolicited messages

examples.en: The spam filter caught most of the advertisements sent to our club inbox.
examples.zh: 「垃圾邮件过滤器」拦下了发到我们社团邮箱的大部分广告。

examples.en: One legitimate signup reminder was caught by the spam filter on my university account.
examples.zh: 我校园账户的「垃圾邮件过滤器」误拦了一封有效的报名提醒。

words.enDefinition: an email held separately after a system flags it for possible security concerns

examples.en: Campus IT reviewed a quarantined email that the student society had been expecting.
examples.zh: 校园信息技术部门审查了一封学生社团一直在等的「被隔离的邮件」。

examples.en: The digest listed one quarantined email from a guest speaker at our college.
examples.zh: 汇总通知列出了一封「被隔离的邮件」，发件人是我们学院的客座讲者。

words.enDefinition: a message telling someone that a mail system has held suspected unsafe emails

examples.en: I received a quarantine notice while waiting for replies to the event invitations.
examples.zh: 我等活动邀请的回信时，收到了一则「邮件隔离通知」。

examples.en: The quarantine notice listed the subject lines of messages held for further checks.
examples.zh: 「邮件隔离通知」列出了需要进一步检查的邮件主题。

words.enDefinition: a notice that an email came from outside your organisation

examples.en: Emails from outside my university often display an external sender warning above the subject.
examples.zh: 我学校以外的机构或个人发来的邮件，常在主题上方显示「外部发件人提示」。

examples.en: The email carried an external sender warning because the guest was using a personal address.
examples.zh: 来宾用的是个人邮箱，所以邮件带有「外部发件人提示」。

words.enDefinition: a notice advising the recipient that an attachment may need to be checked or handled carefully

examples.en: I saw an attachment warning under the subject line and contacted the course administrator.
examples.zh: 我在主题行下面看到「附件安全提醒」，于是联系了课程管理员。

examples.en: Our mail service displayed an attachment warning when I opened the student's message.
examples.zh: 我打开那位学生的消息时，邮件服务显示了一条「附件安全提醒」。

collocations: pay attention to the attachment warning

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that a program prevented a file from being downloaded

examples.en: The browser showed Download blocked when I tried to retrieve the old workshop file.
examples.zh: 我试着下载以前的工作坊文件时，浏览器显示「下载已拦截」。

examples.en: I asked the helpdesk about Download blocked after the course materials stopped opening.
examples.zh: 课程材料打不开后，我去问服务台「下载已拦截」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a browser warning that a site's certificate cannot be verified or has a problem

examples.en: A security certificate warning appeared on the old department site, so I asked the helpdesk.
examples.zh: 旧院系网站弹出「网站安全证书警告」，所以我去问了服务台。

examples.en: I sent the webmaster a screenshot of the security certificate warning on the library site.
examples.zh: 我把图书馆网站上出现的「网站安全证书警告」截图发给了网站管理员。

words.enDefinition: to verify a request or statement using a separate way of contacting the person or organisation

examples.en: Before making a payment, I wanted to confirm through another channel that the request was genuine.
examples.zh: 付款前，我想「通过另一渠道核实」这项请求是否真实。

examples.en: When a message seems unusual, confirm through another channel before taking any further action.
examples.zh: 遇到看起来不寻常的消息时，先「通过另一渠道核实」，再决定怎么办。

collocations: ask someone to confirm through another channel
confirm through another channel before responding

words.enDefinition: to consult an organisation's published list for a person's or office's contact details

examples.en: Please check the official directory for the finance office's number before calling back.
examples.zh: 回电话前，请「查看官方通讯录」查财务处的号码。

examples.en: I decided to check the official directory when the extension in the message looked unfamiliar.
examples.zh: 消息里的分机号看着陌生，我决定「查看官方通讯录」。

collocations: check the official directory for a number
check the official directory before calling

words.enDefinition: to check a request using contact details or evidence separate from the original message

examples.en: My adviser suggested I verify the request independently through the department's website that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，顾问建议我通过院系网站「独立核实请求」。

examples.en: If you're unsure, verify the request independently before you provide information or make a payment.
examples.zh: 如果拿不准，请先「独立核实请求」，再提供信息或付款。

collocations: verify the request independently before responding
take time to verify the request independently

words.enDefinition: to pause before acting and check that a message or request is genuine

examples.en: The security poster advised students to stop and check before trusting urgent payment instructions.
examples.zh: 安全海报提醒学生，遇到催付款的指示要「先停下核实」。

examples.en: I decided to stop and check when the email asked for another tuition payment.
examples.zh: 那封邮件让我再付一次学费，我决定「先停下核实」。

collocations: take a moment to stop and check

words.enDefinition: a guided review of an account's security settings and activity

examples.en: I ran the security checkup after moving my university account to a new phone.
examples.zh: 把校园账户转到新手机后，我运行了「安全检查向导」。

examples.en: The security checkup showed me which devices were still signed in to my account.
examples.zh: 「安全检查向导」显示了还有哪些设备登录着我的账户。

words.enDefinition: options that control how a device, service or account is protected

examples.en: I checked the security settings after switching to my new university email account.
examples.zh: 换成新的学校邮箱账户后，我查看了「安全设置」。

examples.en: The helpdesk explained where the app keeps its security settings on mobile devices.
examples.zh: 服务台解释了移动设备上这个应用的「安全设置」在哪里。

words.enDefinition: measures that help keep an account safe from unauthorised use

examples.en: The orientation guide explains account protection for the university portal and library service.
examples.zh: 入学指南介绍了校园门户和图书馆服务的「账户保护」。

examples.en: Student IT held a workshop on account protection at the beginning of term.
examples.zh: 学期开始时，学生信息技术部门办了一场「账户保护」工作坊。

words.enDefinition: to replace your current password with a different one

examples.en: The help page explains how to change your password from the university portal.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了如何从校园门户「更改密码」。

examples.en: If the service reports that your password has leaked, change your password there promptly.
examples.zh: 如果服务提醒密码已经泄露，请及时在该服务上「更改密码」。

collocations: change your password after a breach

words.enDefinition: the process of setting a new password, often because you cannot use the current one

examples.en: I requested a password reset after forgetting my login for the student portal.
examples.zh: 忘了学生门户的登录密码后，我申请了「密码重置」。

examples.en: The password reset took only a few minutes once I reached the helpdesk.
examples.zh: 联系上服务台后，「密码重置」只花了几分钟。

words.enDefinition: a request to begin the process of setting a new password for an account

examples.en: I received a confirmation after submitting a password reset request on the official page.
examples.zh: 我在官方页面提交「密码重设请求」后，收到了一条确认通知。

examples.en: The helpdesk checked the status of my password reset request during the call.
examples.zh: 通话时，服务台查询了我的「密码重设请求」处理到哪一步。

words.enDefinition: a link that opens the page where an account holder can set a replacement password

examples.en: The official support page said the password reset link would expire after a short time.
examples.zh: 官方支持页面说，「密码重设链接」会在短时间内失效。

examples.en: I requested another password reset link after the first one had stopped working.
examples.zh: 第一个链接失效后，我重新申请了一个「密码重设链接」。

words.enDefinition: a password chosen to resist guessing, typically by being long and hard to predict

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to choose a strong password for the shared course platform.
examples.zh: 导师请我们为共用的课程平台各自选一个「强密码」。

examples.en: I created a strong password when I signed up for the university library app.
examples.zh: 我注册学校图书馆应用时设置了「强密码」。

words.enDefinition: a password used for only one account or service

examples.en: I made a unique password for the portal instead of reusing my email password.
examples.zh: 我给门户设了一个「独立专用的密码」，没有沿用邮箱密码。

examples.en: My password manager generates a unique password whenever I open a new account.
examples.zh: 我每开一个新账户，密码管理器都会生成一个「独立专用的密码」。

collocations: use a unique password for each site

words.enDefinition: using the same password for multiple accounts or services

examples.en: The campus security workshop explained why password reuse can put several accounts at risk.
examples.zh: 校园安全工作坊解释了为什么「重复使用密码」会让多个账户面临风险。

examples.en: I learned about password reuse after my old music account appeared in a breach notice.
examples.zh: 旧的音乐账户出现在泄露通知里之后，我才了解「重复使用密码」的问题。

words.enDefinition: a password that is relatively easy to guess or predict

examples.en: The registration page rejected my weak password before it let me create the account.
examples.zh: 注册页面拒绝了我的「弱密码」，所以账户当时没有创建成功。

examples.en: Campus IT explained why a weak password can leave a university account exposed.
examples.zh: 校园信息技术部门解释了为什么「弱密码」会给校园账户带来安全风险。

words.zhGloss: 已泄露或不再安全的密码
words.enDefinition: a password that is known or suspected to be available to someone without permission
acceptedZhAnswers: 已泄露或不再安全的密码

examples.en: A warning about a compromised password appeared when I signed in to the library service.
examples.zh: 我登录图书馆服务时，出现了一则有关「已泄露或不再安全的密码」的警告。

examples.en: The helpdesk asked me to replace the compromised password from the official portal.
examples.zh: 服务台请我通过官方门户换掉「已泄露或不再安全的密码」。

words.enDefinition: software that stores and manages login details, and often generates passwords

examples.en: I use a password manager to keep separate passwords for my student accounts.
examples.zh: 我用「密码管理器」为各个学生账户保存不同的密码。

examples.en: The helpdesk explained how a password manager differs from keeping passwords in a spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 服务台解释了用「密码管理器」和把密码记在表格里有什么不同。

words.enDefinition: a tool that creates passwords, usually using randomly selected characters or words

examples.en: The password generator suggested a new password when I registered for the campus service.
examples.zh: 我注册校园服务时，「密码生成器」建议了一个新密码。

examples.en: I opened the password generator within my manager when making a new student account.
examples.zh: 创建新的学生账户时，我打开了密码管理器自带的「密码生成器」。

words.enDefinition: a protected store for login information, typically provided by a password manager

examples.en: My password vault keeps the login records for both of my student accounts.
examples.zh: 我的「密码保险库」保管着两个学生账户的登录信息。

examples.en: The password vault locked when my laptop went to sleep during the lecture.
examples.zh: 我上课时电脑进入睡眠状态，「密码保险库」随之锁定。

collocations: store a login in a password vault

words.enDefinition: a feature that enters a stored password into a sign-in form for you

examples.en: I used password autofill when signing in to the university portal on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上登录校园门户时用了「自动填充密码」。

examples.en: The instructor demonstrated password autofill on a practice account during the workshop about accessibility.
examples.zh: 导师在无障碍工作坊上用练习账户演示了「自动填充密码」。

words.enDefinition: the main password that unlocks a password manager or other protected store

examples.en: My master password unlocks the vault where I keep the rest of my logins.
examples.zh: 我的「主密码」用来解锁保管其他登录信息的保险库。

examples.en: The guide explains what to do if you forget the master password for your vault.
examples.zh: 指南解释了忘记保险库的「主密码」时该怎么办。

words.enDefinition: a relatively long password made from words or other memorable elements

examples.en: I chose a passphrase because I could remember several unrelated words more easily.
examples.zh: 我选了「密码短语」，因为几个互不相关的词更好记。

examples.en: Our tutor explained the idea of a passphrase during the student security workshop.
examples.zh: 导师在学生安全工作坊上解释了「密码短语」这个概念。

words.enDefinition: an incident in which private or protected data is accessed or disclosed without authorisation

examples.en: The university notified former students after a data breach at an outside service provider.
examples.zh: 一家外部服务商发生「数据泄露事件」后，学校通知了往届学生。

examples.en: The student newspaper explained what information was affected by the data breach last month.
examples.zh: 校报解释了上个月的「数据泄露事件」影响了哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: a notice that informs affected people or authorities about a data breach

examples.en: The breach notification included a contact address for former students who had questions.
examples.zh: 「数据泄露通知」留了一个联系方式，供有疑问的往届学生使用。

examples.en: I read the breach notification on the university's official website before taking any action.
examples.zh: 采取行动前，我先在学校官网阅读了「数据泄露通知」。

words.enDefinition: an incident in which another person gains unauthorised control of or access to an account

examples.en: The helpdesk investigated a possible account compromise after the student noticed unfamiliar activity.
examples.zh: 那位学生发现不熟悉的活动后，服务台调查了一起可能的「账户安全失守事件」。

examples.en: We covered account compromise in training for volunteers who manage the society's email.
examples.zh: 给管理社团邮箱的志愿者培训时，我们讲到了「账户安全失守事件」。

words.enDefinition: an attempt to sign in that appears unusual and may not be authorised

examples.en: The app flagged a suspicious sign-in when I was travelling to another campus.
examples.zh: 我在去另一个校区的路上，应用标记了一次「可疑登录」。

examples.en: I contacted the university helpdesk after the portal reported a suspicious sign-in overnight.
examples.zh: 门户报告夜里有一次「可疑登录」后，我联系了学校服务台。

words.enDefinition: the approximate geographical location associated with an account sign-in

examples.en: The login location appeared to be different while I was using the campus network.
examples.zh: 我在用校园网络时，显示的「登录位置」似乎并不是我所在的地方。

examples.en: I checked the login location against the city where I attended the workshop.
examples.zh: 我看了「登录位置」是否与参加工作坊的城市一致。

words.enDefinition: a record of past attempts to sign in to an account or system

examples.en: I checked my sign-in history after noticing a message about an unfamiliar computer.
examples.zh: 我看到有条消息提到陌生电脑，于是查看了「登录记录」。

examples.en: The sign-in history showed the last time I had used the campus computers.
examples.zh: 「登录记录」显示了我上次使用校园电脑是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: recent actions or alerts that affect the security of an account

examples.en: I reviewed recent security activity before calling the helpdesk about my account settings.
examples.zh: 我先查看了「近期安全活动」，然后打电话向服务台咨询账户设置。

examples.en: The app lists recent security activity on the same page as your account settings.
examples.zh: 应用把「近期安全活动」列在账户设置所在的同一页。

words.enDefinition: a notification that an account has been used on a device not seen before

examples.en: I expected a new device alert when I signed in on my replacement phone.
examples.zh: 我用换的新手机登录时，就知道会收到「新设备登录提醒」。

examples.en: A new device alert appeared on my tablet during the library's computer orientation.
examples.zh: 图书馆讲解电脑使用时，我的平板弹出了一条「新设备登录提醒」。

words.enDefinition: a device that a service or user does not recognise as previously associated with an account

examples.en: The page listed an unrecognized device that I did not remember using at college.
examples.zh: 页面列出了一台「不熟悉的设备」，我不记得自己在学校用过它。

examples.en: I asked the helpdesk about an unrecognized device in my university account settings.
examples.zh: 我向服务台咨询了校园账户设置里的一台「不熟悉的设备」。

collocations: an alert for an unrecognized device

words.enDefinition: to sign an account out of a currently connected session

examples.en: I used my account page to end an active session on the library computer.
examples.zh: 我用账户页面「结束当前登录会话」，那次登录是在图书馆电脑上。

examples.en: Our adviser explained how to end an active session after using a shared device.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了使用公用设备后，如何「结束当前登录会话」。

collocations: choose to end an active session
end an active session on a shared device

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that an account cannot be used for a limited period or until a check is completed

examples.en: I saw Account temporarily locked when I entered the wrong password several times.
examples.zh: 我输错好几次密码后，看到了「账户已暂时锁定」。

examples.en: When Account temporarily locked appeared again, I contacted the helpdesk from the official portal.
examples.zh: 再次出现「账户已暂时锁定」时，我通过官方门户联系了服务台。

words.enDefinition: to take steps that prevent unwanted access to your account

examples.en: The guide suggests ways to secure your account before using computers at the library.
examples.zh: 指南介绍了在使用图书馆电脑前如何「保护账户安全」。

examples.en: The university explains where to find help if you need to secure your account.
examples.zh: 学校说明了如果需要「保护账户安全」，可以去哪里求助。

collocations: take steps to secure your account
learn how to secure your account
secure your account after an alert

words.enDefinition: to change the contact information or options used to regain access to an account

examples.en: I remembered to update recovery details before giving up my old mobile number.
examples.zh: 停用旧手机号码之前，我记得先「更新账户找回信息」。

examples.en: Our adviser reminded students to update recovery details when they move to another country.
examples.zh: 顾问提醒学生，搬到另一个国家时要「更新账户找回信息」。

collocations: update recovery details in account settings

words.zhGloss: 用于找回账户的手机号码
words.enDefinition: a phone number registered as a way to regain access to your account
acceptedZhAnswers: 用于找回账户的手机号码

examples.en: I changed my recovery phone number after switching from an overseas mobile plan.
examples.zh: 我停用原来的海外手机套餐后，更改了「用于找回账户的手机号码」。

examples.en: The portal asked me to check that my recovery phone number still worked.
examples.zh: 门户请我确认「用于找回账户的手机号码」还能用。

words.enDefinition: a code kept for signing in when the usual verification method is unavailable

examples.en: I stored a backup code where I could find it after replacing my phone.
examples.zh: 我把「备用登录码」存到了更换手机后也能找到的地方。

examples.en: The instructions explain when to use a backup code for the student portal.
examples.zh: 说明里写着什么时候可以用「备用登录码」登录学生门户。

words.enDefinition: the process of checking that someone is allowed to sign in to an account

examples.en: The portal requires login verification when you use a device outside the campus network.
examples.zh: 在校园网外的设备上使用门户时，需要进行「登录身份验证」。

examples.en: I completed login verification before the library app displayed the books I had borrowed.
examples.zh: 我完成「登录身份验证」后，图书馆应用才显示我借的书。

words.enDefinition: sign-in protection that requires proof from at least two different types of authentication factor

examples.en: Our student portal uses multi-factor authentication, especially when people sign in from new devices.
examples.zh: 学生门户采用「多因素身份验证」，尤其是用户换了设备登录时。

examples.en: The helpdesk ran a workshop on multi-factor authentication before the new term began.
examples.zh: 新学期开始前，服务台开了一场关于「多因素身份验证」的工作坊。

words.enDefinition: a type of evidence used to verify identity, such as something you know, possess or are

examples.en: Our tutor explained that possession of a security key can be an authentication factor.
examples.zh: 导师解释，持有安全密钥可以作为一种「身份验证因素」。

examples.en: A password counts as an authentication factor based on what the user knows.
examples.zh: 密码属于基于用户所知信息的「身份验证因素」。

words.enDefinition: a particular technique or tool used to check someone's identity during sign-in

examples.en: I chose a different authentication method after moving my account to a new device.
examples.zh: 我把账户移到新设备后，换了一种「身份验证方式」。

examples.en: The university lets students choose an authentication method that works on their own devices.
examples.zh: 学校允许学生选一种自己设备支持的「身份验证方式」。

words.enDefinition: a notification or screen asking you to confirm your identity or a particular action

examples.en: A verification prompt appeared when I opened the student portal on my new tablet.
examples.zh: 我在新平板上打开学生门户时，弹出了一条「验证提示」。

examples.en: The support page explains why you sometimes see a verification prompt after changing settings.
examples.zh: 支持页面解释了为什么更改设置后有时会看到「验证提示」。

words.enDefinition: confirmation that a particular attempt to sign in should be allowed

examples.en: The app asked for sign-in approval before I could open my university mailbox.
examples.zh: 在我能打开学校邮箱之前，应用要求「登录确认」。

examples.en: My password was accepted, but the computer was still waiting for sign-in approval.
examples.zh: 我的密码验证通过了，但电脑仍在等待「登录确认」。

words.enDefinition: a request to verify a sign-in that you did not start or expect

examples.en: An unexpected sign-in prompt appeared while my laptop was still closed in my bag.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑还合着放在包里时，我收到了一条「意外出现的登录提示」。

examples.en: The helpdesk asked when I first saw the unexpected sign-in prompt on my phone.
examples.zh: 服务台问我什么时候第一次在手机上看到「意外出现的登录提示」。

words.enDefinition: to stop a pending sign-in by indicating that it should not be approved

examples.en: I chose to deny a sign-in request because I had not tried to log in.
examples.zh: 我没有尝试登录，所以选择「拒绝登录请求」。

examples.en: The adviser demonstrated how to deny a sign-in request during the account safety workshop.
examples.zh: 顾问在账户安全工作坊上演示了如何「拒绝登录请求」。

collocations: choose to deny a sign-in request
deny a sign-in request you do not recognise
learn how to deny a sign-in request

words.enDefinition: an app that helps verify sign-ins, for example through temporary codes or confirmation requests

examples.en: I set up an authenticator app before using my student account on a second device.
examples.zh: 在第二台设备上用学生账户之前，我先设置了「身份验证应用」。

examples.en: The authenticator app showed my university account alongside the other accounts I had added.
examples.zh: 「身份验证应用」把校园账户和我添加的其他账户一起列了出来。

words.enDefinition: a physical device that verifies your identity when you sign in to a supported service

examples.en: I borrowed a security key from campus IT to test it with my account.
examples.zh: 我向校园信息技术部门借了一个「实体安全密钥」，用自己的账户试了试。

examples.en: The library guide explains how to register a security key for the student portal.
examples.zh: 图书馆指南解释了如何给学生门户登记「实体安全密钥」。

words.enDefinition: a digital sign-in credential that uses cryptography and usually asks you to unlock a device

examples.en: I created a passkey for the reading app using the settings on my phone.
examples.zh: 我通过手机设置给阅读应用创建了「通行密钥」。

examples.en: Her passkey let her sign in without entering a password on the student website.
examples.zh: 有了「通行密钥」，她不用输入密码就登录了学生网站。

collocations: use a passkey to sign in

words.enDefinition: signing in without typing an account password, using another form of verification

examples.en: The student portal offered passwordless sign-in as an option alongside its existing password form.
examples.zh: 学生门户在原有的密码表单之外，提供了「无密码登录」选项。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated passwordless sign-in using a test account during the orientation session.
examples.zh: 入学培训时，导师用测试账户演示了「无密码登录」。

words.enDefinition: to access an account by using a saved passkey rather than typing an account password

examples.en: I could sign in with a passkey once I had set up my new phone.
examples.zh: 设置好新手机后，我就能「用通行密钥登录」。

examples.en: The portal asked whether I wanted to sign in with a passkey this time.
examples.zh: 门户问我这次要不要「用通行密钥登录」。

collocations: choose to sign in with a passkey
try to sign in with a passkey
sign in with a passkey on your phone

words.enDefinition: a code entered to unlock a phone, tablet or similar device

examples.en: I entered my device passcode after restarting the tablet for my morning lecture notes.
examples.zh: 为了看上午的课堂笔记，我重启了平板，然后输入「设备解锁密码」。

examples.en: The new device passcode was different from the password for my university account.
examples.zh: 新的「设备解锁密码」和我的校园账户密码不同。

words.enDefinition: a feature that prevents use of a device until the user unlocks it

examples.en: I enabled the screen lock before starting to take my phone to group rehearsals.
examples.zh: 开始带手机去集体排练前，我先启用了「屏幕锁」。

examples.en: My screen lock turned on automatically while I was taking notes in the seminar.
examples.zh: 我在研讨课上记笔记时，手机的「屏幕锁」自动开启了。

words.enDefinition: a setting that locks a device after a chosen period without activity

examples.en: I enabled automatic screen lock on the tablet I use in the university café.
examples.zh: 我给在校园咖啡馆用的平板开了「自动锁屏」。

examples.en: The support page explains how to adjust automatic screen lock during presentations and classes.
examples.zh: 支持页面解释了演示和上课时如何调整「自动锁屏」设置。

words.enDefinition: a change to software intended to address security problems or improve protection

examples.en: The computer installed a security update while I was away at a seminar.
examples.zh: 我去上研讨课时，电脑安装了一次「安全更新」。

examples.en: Campus IT recommended installing the security update before connecting to the student network.
examples.zh: 校园信息技术部门建议在连学生网络前先安装这次「安全更新」。

words.enDefinition: a setting or service that applies security updates with little or no user action

examples.en: I enabled automatic security updates so my laptop would stay current during the semester.
examples.zh: 我启用了「自动安全更新」，让笔记本在学期里及时得到保护。

examples.en: The help page shows where to turn on automatic security updates for the operating system.
examples.zh: 帮助页面标出了在哪里能开启操作系统的「自动安全更新」。

words.enDefinition: a software fix that addresses one or more specific security flaws

examples.en: The vendor released a security patch for the version installed in the computer lab.
examples.zh: 供应商发布了一个适用于机房所装版本的「安全补丁」。

examples.en: Our lab administrator applied the security patch before students returned for the afternoon session.
examples.zh: 同学们回来上下午的课前，机房管理员安装了「安全补丁」。

words.enDefinition: use of an account, system or information without the right to do so

examples.en: The helpdesk investigated possible unauthorized access after an alert appeared on my student account.
examples.zh: 我的学生账户弹出提醒后，服务台调查了可能的「未经授权的访问」。

examples.en: The training explained how the university records reports of unauthorized access to its systems.
examples.zh: 培训介绍了学校如何记录有关系统遭「未经授权的访问」的报告。

words.enDefinition: to end a sign-in session on a device from another device or location

examples.en: I decided to sign out remotely after leaving my university session open on a library computer.
examples.zh: 我把校园账户留在图书馆电脑上没退出，于是决定「远程退出登录」。

examples.en: The helpdesk showed me where to sign out remotely from my missing tablet.
examples.zh: 服务台告诉我去哪里操作，就能从丢失的平板上「远程退出登录」。

collocations: learn how to sign out remotely
sign out remotely from a lost device

words.enDefinition: to tell a service or its support team about actions you do not recognise

examples.en: I used the official support page to report unusual activity on my student account.
examples.zh: 我通过官方支持页面「报告异常活动」，涉及我的学生账户。

examples.en: The helpdesk explained where students should report unusual activity if they cannot sign in.
examples.zh: 服务台解释了学生无法登录时应该去哪里「报告异常活动」。

collocations: learn how to report unusual activity

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that you must set a new password to continue using a service

examples.en: I saw Password change required when I opened the portal after the winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假结束后我打开门户，看到了「必须更改密码」的提示。

examples.en: The helpdesk confirmed why Password change required appeared on the computer in the library.
examples.zh: 服务台确认了图书馆电脑上为什么会出现「必须更改密码」。

words.enDefinition: to examine the recent actions or sign-ins recorded for an account

examples.en: I wanted to review account activity before calling the university helpdesk about the alert.
examples.zh: 我想先「查看账户活动」，再打电话向学校服务台咨询提醒的事。

examples.en: The student handbook shows how to review account activity from the profile settings page.
examples.zh: 学生手册介绍了如何从个人资料设置页「查看账户活动」。

collocations: learn how to review account activity
review account activity after an alert

words.enDefinition: an event that an organisation has verified as affecting its data, accounts or systems

examples.en: The student newspaper reported a confirmed security incident after the university published its statement.
examples.zh: 学校发出声明后，校报报道了这起「已确认的安全事件」。

examples.en: The helpdesk notice referred to a confirmed security incident at an external service provider.
examples.zh: 服务台的通知提到一家外部服务商发生了「已确认的安全事件」。

collocations: respond to a confirmed security incident
notify users of a confirmed security incident

words.enDefinition: the available ways to regain access when you cannot sign in to an account

examples.en: I checked my recovery options before changing the phone number linked to my account.
examples.zh: 更换账户绑定的电话号码前，我查看了「账户找回选项」。

examples.en: The account page listed two recovery options at the end of the security checklist.
examples.zh: 账户安全检查清单的最后列出了两种「账户找回选项」。

words.enDefinition: an option used to tell a service that you did not carry out an action it recorded

examples.en: I selected I don't recognize this activity after checking the time shown in the alert.
examples.zh: 我核对提醒上的时间后，选了「这不是我的操作」。

examples.en: The support page explains what happens after you tap I don't recognize this activity.
examples.zh: 支持页面解释了点按「这不是我的操作」之后会发生什么。

collocations: an option that says "I don't recognize this activity"

words.enDefinition: an action that tries to enter an account, whether or not it succeeds

examples.en: I saw a sign-in attempt listed just before the account stopped accepting my password.
examples.zh: 账户不再接受我的密码前，我看到记录里有一次「登录尝试」。

examples.en: The system recorded my first sign-in attempt from the computer in the language lab.
examples.zh: 系统记录了我从语言实验室的电脑发起的第一次「登录尝试」。

words.enDefinition: a record submitted to an organisation about an actual or suspected security incident

examples.en: I filed a security incident report through the page listed in the student handbook.
examples.zh: 我通过学生手册上列出的网站提交了一份「安全事件报告」。

examples.en: The adviser helped me add the correct time to my security incident report that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，顾问帮我把正确的时间补进了「安全事件报告」。
